name: GoHighLevel Agency Client Onboarding (Stripe to n8n to GHL)

parameters.content:
## 1. Start and the Stripe signature
Stripe, the Retry webhook and the native GoHighLevel workflows all start at **Load Settings**, which checks every setting once. A Stripe call is verified before anything else: HMAC SHA-256 over the timestamp and the raw body, every v1 signature, compared in constant time, within STRIPE_TOLERANCE_SECONDS. Events this workflow does not use get a 200 at once, so Stripe does not send them again. A bad signature gets 400 and an alert.

## 8. Stuck run check
Every 15 minutes: an onboarding still in progress with no change for STUCK_CHECK_MINUTES, while no run holds the lock, was cut off (an n8n restart, for example). It is marked failed and reported, so the Retry webhook can finish it.

## 2. One onboarding at a time
A lock row in the ledger table is taken with one conditional update. A second delivery of the same event (or a retry) waits up to LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS; if the lock is still held, Stripe gets 503 and sends the event again later. A lock left by a crashed run runs out after 15 minutes. A lock that cannot be taken at all ends with 500 and an alert.

## 3. The event's ledger row
One row per Stripe event: status, the steps already finished and the IDs they created. A finished event, or a second event for a session that is already onboarded, is a duplicate (200, nothing done). The row is saved before Stripe gets its 200.

## 4. Onboarding steps
**Step Engine** runs the steps in order: sub-account from the snapshot, admin user, custom values, contact, opportunity, note, new client tag, Slack. Each finished step is saved to the ledger with its IDs before the next one starts. Creates only go out after a lookup found nothing, so a retry picks up what an earlier run made instead of making a second one.

## 5. GoHighLevel and Slack
Agency app (OAuth2): sub-account, snapshot, app install, user, sub-account token. Sub-account token: calendars, custom values. GHL_HOME_TOKEN: contact, opportunity, note, tag.

## Replies
**Check Reply** decides: 429 waits Retry-After and repeats, 5xx backs off, a failed create goes back to a lookup, 401 / 403 / 4xx stop with the reason.

## 6. Finish
The ledger gets the result and the lock is released. A run that left anything open fails, and the alert lists what exists (with IDs) and what is still to do. The Retry webhook continues from the first open step.

## 7. Status calls from GoHighLevel
The native workflows in the agency sub-account post kickoff booked or kickoff not booked here, with the X-Onboarding-Secret header. The ledger row gets the kickoff status and Slack gets a note.
